        "contents": "CREATE TABLE promotion_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    promotion_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '推广策略ID',\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\n    importance_level ENUM('核心', '重要', '一般', '辅助') DEFAULT '重要' COMMENT '重要程度',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_promotion_tech (promotion_id, tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_promotion (promotion_id),\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 10. 通稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE press_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    press_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '通稿ID',\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\n    mention_type ENUM('主要', '次要', '引用') DEFAULT '主要' COMMENT '提及类型',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_press_tech (press_id, tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_press (press_id),\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\n    FOREIGN KEY (press_id) REFERENCES tech_press_releases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "CREATE TABLE promotion_tech_points (",

          },

            "text": "    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,",

        "contents": "-- 项目数据管理重构迁移脚本\n-- 创建日期: 2025-12-05\n-- 说明: 重构项目数据管理架构，以\"项目\"为核心关联所有相关数据\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 1. 确保 projects 表存在（如果不存在则创建）\n-- ==============================================\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    cover_image TEXT,\n    icon TEXT,\n    type TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' CHECK (type IN ('normal', 'featured')),\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    created_by TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_opened_at DATETIME\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 2. 项目关联基础信息表（多对多关系）\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 项目与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与公开知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(project_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 项目与文件关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_files (\n    ",

        "contents": "| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |\n| application_status | VARCHAR(50) | 应用状态 |\n| implementation_date | DATE | 实施日期 |\n| notes | TEXT | 备注 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n**唯一约束**：(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\n\n### 2.3 第三层：AI内容生成层\n\n#### 2.3.1 知识点表 (knowledge_points)\n\n存储从AI搜索等来源获取的知识点。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| title | TEXT | 标题 |\n| content | TEXT | 内容 |\n| source_query | TEXT | 来源查询 |\n| source_url | TEXT | 来源URL |\n| source_type | TEXT | 来源类型：ai_search/manual/import |\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON格式的元数据 |\n| tags | TEXT | JSON格式的标签 |\n| relevance_score | REAL | 相关度分数 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\n| dify_task_id | TEXT | Dify任务ID |\n| ai_search_session_id | TEXT | AI搜索会话ID |\n| created_by | INTEGER | 创建者ID |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.3.2 技术包装材料表 (tech_packaging_materials)\n\n存储AI生成的技术包装材料。\n\n#### 2.3.3 技术推广策略表 (tech_promotion_strategies)\n\n存储AI生成的技术推广策略。\n\n#### 2.3.4 技术通稿表 (tech_press_releases)\n\n存储AI生成的技术通稿。\n\n#### 2.3.5 技术演讲稿表 (tech_speeches)\n\n存储AI生成的技术演讲稿。\n\n### 2.4 第四层：工作流与对话层\n\n#### 2.4.1 Agent工作流表 (agent_workflows)\n\n存储Agent工作流定义。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | TEXT | 主键 |\n| name | TEXT | 工作流名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| version | TEXT | 版本号（默认'1.0.0'） |\n| nodes | TEXT | JSON字符串，节点列表 |\n| edges | TEXT | JSON字符串，连接边列表 |\n| metadata | TEXT | JSON字符串，元数据 |\n| published | INTEGER | 是否已发布（0/1） |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMP | 创建时间 |",

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建技术点\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateTechPointDTO): Promise&lt;TechPoint&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO tech_points (\n        name, description, category_id, parent_id, level, tech_type, \n        priority, status, tags, technical_details, benefits, applications, \n        keywords, source_url, created_by\n      )\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n      RETURNING *\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      data.name,\n      data.description || null,\n      data.category_id || null,\n      data.parent_id || null,\n      data.level || 1,\n      data.tech_type || TechType.FEATURE,\n      data.priority || Priority.MEDIUM,\n      data.status || Status.DRAFT,\n      data.tags ? JSON.stringify(data.tags) : null,\n      data.technical_details ? JSON.stringify(data.technical_details) : null,\n      data.benefits ? JSON.stringify(data.benefits) : null,\n      data.applications ? JSON.stringify(data.applications) : null,\n      data.keywords ? JSON.stringify(data.keywords) : null,\n      data.source_url || null,\n      data.created_by || null\n    ];\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return this.parseJsonFields(result[0]) as TechPoint;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取技术点\n   */\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&lt;TechPoint | null&gt; {\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM tech_points WHERE id = ?';\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- Todify3 数据库创建脚本\n-- 创建数据库\nCREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;\nUSE todify3;\n\n-- 1. 技术分类表\nCREATE TABLE tech_categories (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);\n\n-- 2. 车型车系表\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\n);\n\n-- 3. 技术点表\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "-- Todify3 数据库创建脚本",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "-- 创建数据库",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "USE todify3;",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "-- 1. 技术分类表",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE TABLE tech_categories (",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": ");",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "-- 2. 车型车系表",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "CREATE TABLE car_models (",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',",
            "lineNumber": 25

          {
            "text": "    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',",
